video.title: Preview, Canvas & Sample Data | Day 148
video.description:
Learn to explain how to check a SwiftUI screen without running the app: Preview, Canvas & Sample Data, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Preview - A live picture of a view that Xcode shows while you write code.
Canvas - The Xcode panel next to your code that shows the previews.
Sample Data - Fake values that you give a view, so a preview has something to show.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.description:
Explain Preview, Canvas & Sample Data in SwiftUI by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
프리뷰, 캔버스, 샘플 데이터 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Preview - A live picture of a view that Xcode shows while you write code.
한국어: 프리뷰: 코드를 쓰는 동안 Xcode가 보여 주는 뷰의 실시간 미리보기

Canvas - The Xcode panel next to your code that shows the previews.
한국어: 캔버스: 코드 옆에서 프리뷰를 보여 주는 Xcode 패널

Sample Data - Fake values that you give a view, so a preview has something to show.
한국어: 샘플 데이터: 프리뷰에 보여 줄 내용이 있도록 뷰에 주는 가짜 값

landscape.hook: Can you explain Preview, Canvas and Sample Data in English?

dialogue.title: Stop running the app

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, I run the app every time to see my screen. It is slow.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use a Preview. It shows a live picture of your view while you type.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: In the Canvas, the panel next to the code. If it is closed, open it from the Editor menu.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: My Preview crashes because the note is missing.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Give the Preview Sample Data. A fake note, like `sample` in the code.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Should the Sample Data come from the real server?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No. Use fixed values, so the Canvas always loads fast.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can I see dark mode too?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. Name a second Preview, like `Dark`, and it gets its own tab in the Canvas.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So one Preview for each important state.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Exactly. A small Preview with Sample Data makes UI work much faster.
